model: Geberit Connect (Geberit Gateway + GEBUS end devices)
applies_to: Geberit Connect: the BTL-listed Geberit Gateway (BACnet IP) and the WC/urinal flush controls, washbasin taps, hygiene flush units and sensors linked to it over GEBUS.
summary: The Geberit Gateway publishes every connected end device as its own set of BACnet IP objects, plus collective groups per zone and device type. Each object has a fixed object number (000-399); the real instance adds the device position, device type and zone. Status objects give connectivity, warnings, errors and usage; counters give flushes and water use; control objects start flushes, set flush volumes and cleaning mode.
notes: Applies-to codes in descriptions: GW gateway, WT washbasin tap, WC WC flush control, UR urinal, SE GEBUS sensor, HS hygiene flush unit; (all) = every type.

Template list: instance shown = object number (000-399), which is also the gateway's own instance. End-device instance = object number + position x 400 + device type x 12,400 + zone x 186,000 (device type 1 WC, 2 urinal, 3 washbasin tap, 4 sensor, 5 hygiene flush unit; 0 = collective group).
Full object names carry a prefix, e.g. Gateway.DeviceSerial or Zone.1.Toilet.1.WaterUsage (instance 198970 in the manual's example).
Objects are created when an end device is assigned to the gateway; which ones exist depends on the device type (see Applies to).
Structured View objects (gateway, zone, device-type and device groups), the Device object and the Network Port object are not listed.
Most status and counter objects also exist for collective groups (zone, device type), e.g. total water use for a zone.

integration.summary: Map ConnectionStatus, GenericWarning and GenericError for each device or collective group and alarm on them; trend WaterUsage and FlushCount. The BMS can start flushes and switch cleaning mode.
setup: Device instance is set in the Geberit app (factory setting: serial number).
Read the instance formula before mapping; collective groups use position 0 and/or device type 0.
gotchas: On a collective group a mixed value reads as Indeterminate (MV) or 4294967295 (FlushTime).
Errors and warnings must be read out on site with the Geberit Control app.
